title: 1ST EDITION VTG Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Shadow of Eyes Pharaoh's Servant Psv-075 Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a 1ST EDITION VTG Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card from the Set "Pharaoh's Servant". It features the character "Shadow of Eyes" and is classified as a Trap-Trap-Normal card. The card is English language, manufactured by Konami, and has a regular finish. It is a Common / Short Print rarity, making it a desirable collectible for fans of Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG.
